    <div class="section-kicker"><span class="section-number">01 /</span><p class="eyebrow">The missing picture</p></div>

      <h2 id="mission-title">Health doesn’t happen<br>in a vacuum.</h2>
      <div class="mission-copy"><p>Nearly a quarter of deaths worldwide are linked to modifiable environmental factors.<sup><a href="#source-note" aria-label="Source: World Health Organization, 2016">1</a></sup> Yet we still understand little about how everyday exposures affect individual health.</p><p class="statement">We’re building the intelligence layer to close that gap.</p></div>
